---
title: "simstim image save"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Save a running microvm's system changes as an image on its host.

```text
simstim image save <host>/<session> <ref> [flags]
```

Saves a running microvm's root image and system changes after a review. Workspaces, credentials, agent state and temporary files are left out. Treat the image as private to its host: a login copied to another path can remain in it.

## Examples

```sh
simstim image save my-vps/auth-fix devtools
simstim new my-vps --image devtools
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--allow-flagged` | save the listed changes that can run code at login or at start after reviewing them |
| `--json` | print JSON for scripts, and ask nothing (see docs/how-to/scripting.md) |
| `--replace` | replace this host's existing saved image name |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
| `--no-color` | print no colour (NO_COLOR does the same) |
| `--no-input` | ask nothing: a question that needs an answer fails with exit code 4, and names the flag that answers it (SIMSTIM_NO_INPUT=1 does the same) |

Part of [`image`](image.md): list, pull, save and remove microvm root images.
